quarterly_data.signal: The half-year 2026 management report lists further regulatory approvals: the FDA approved Dupixent, after priority review, for patients aged 6 years and older with allergic fungal rhinosinusitis who have a history of sino-nasal surgery; the European Commission (EC) approved Dupixent for children aged two to 11 years with chronic spontaneous urticaria; the EC granted Rezurock a conditional marketing authorization for chronic graft-versus-host disease on March 31, 2026; in April the FDA expanded Tzield to patients as young as one year old to delay the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes; and the CHMP issued a positive opinion on acoziborole, a single-dose oral medicine for sleeping sickness.
quarterly_data.figure: FDA: Dupixent AFRS, Tzield (April, from one year old); EC: Dupixent CSU children, Rezurock conditional authorization (March 31, 2026); CHMP positive opinion: acoziborole
